title: Worcester Greenstore cylinders Guide | G3 Cylinder Knowledge
description: Greenstore cylinder instructions are version-specific. Match the manufacturing period and cylinder model before following service guidance.

sections.heading: Identify the product family
paragraphs: The official Greenstore SC literature page lists versions for different manufacturing periods. Greenstore is a storage-cylinder range and must not be confused with Greenstar boiler naming.

sections.heading: Why the distinction matters
paragraphs: No hot water can reflect a connected boiler or control issue, while discharge points toward cylinder-system investigation. Record both labels when a Worcester boiler and cylinder work together.

sections.heading: A useful service enquiry
paragraphs: Provide the brand, exact model, serial label if readable, heating source and postcode. Note whether the issue is water temperature, flow, discharge or a connected controller. The business can discuss the enquiry and establish competence, scope and availability; this guide does not promise that every product or component can be repaired.

sections.heading: Independent information
paragraphs: Manufacturer sources below identify the equipment. This website is an independent service business and is not claiming an official partnership with the manufacturer. Parts compatibility and current supply must be checked for the installed model.

faqs.question: Is Greenstore the same appliance as a Worcester Greenstar boiler?
faqs.answer: No. Greenstore names a cylinder range; Greenstar is boiler branding. Record both models where the appliances are connected.
